cases.purpose: Relayed request selects the first configured subnet and echoes option 82.
cases.oracle: Independent fixed DHCP/BOOTP fields and option encodings; controlled guest-local hook where applicable. No server socket is opened.
cases.comparison: Offline response only. Apply the pinned primary-owned data-only gate to complete raw diagnostics; raw runner labels alone are not qualification. Hook failure and missing-hook cases also require a qualified same-build commit baseline.
cases.script:
IFS= read -r request < request.hex
dhcpd respond "$request" -c server.conf -l leases > "$HOME/farm600-dhcp-server-reply.out" 2> "$HOME/farm600-dhcp-server-reply.err"
rc=$?
printf "%s\n" "$rc" > "$HOME/farm600-dhcp-server-status.raw"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-dhcp-server-reviewed.py verify relay-a "$rc"
